evidence: slot_contract.rs:256-288 accepts size=1 and offset=usize::MAX (numeric string or saturating float cast); tree_builder.rs:142-144 installs the grid slot; UiGridSlotPlacement::with_span only applies max(1); layout/pass/measure.rs:569 and arrange/grid_masonry.rs:162 use column + column_span.max(1). extracted_grid_probe.rs copies actual MUI helpers and end expression, with overflow checks enabled it exits 101; disabled the end wraps to 0 and leaves resolved_columns=12 despite the maximum column placement.
impact_or_question: A valid TOML attribute string representing target usize::MAX with a size=1 child reaches layout; debug builds panic, release builds wrap the column end and compute incorrect grid dimensions. The integer limit applied to explicit slot layout does not cover this path.
next_action: Route MUI size/offset admission through bounded discrete validation and guard combined column end in layout consumers; add end-to-end template grid tests for oversized scalar and responsive attributes.

evidence: slot_contract.rs:25-59 picks explicit defaults column=0/span=1 for any layout table, even padding-only. layout/pass/responsive_mui.rs:230-232 and child_has_explicit_slot_layout:530-538 skip all MUI grid item updates when metadata.slot_attributes has layout. Existing template/slot_contracts and template_grid_flow tests do not combine padding-only layout with MUI size/offset.
impact_or_question: A MUI child with attributes size=6/offset=2 and slot layout padding alone receives column=0/span=1. The behavior is proven, but there is no evidence whether whole-table override is intentional or should be fieldwise.
next_action: Confirm authoring priority with template/layout owners and add two-child geometry tests for absent, padding-only and explicitly positioned slot layouts across viewport changes.
